normalized_text: The Saturn V was a rocket NASA built to send people to the moon. It was developed at NASA's Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama. The first Saturn V was launched in 1967 and was called Apollo 4. Apollo 6 followed in 1968. The first Saturn V launched with a crew was Apollo 8. Saturn V rockets made it possible for astronauts to land on the moon on Apollo 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, and 17. The Apollo mission Saturn V rockets had three stages.
